propertySets.name: Pset_FlowInstrumentTypeThermometer
propertySets.definition: A device that reads and displays a temperature value at a point.

properties.name: ThermometerType
properties.definition: Identifies the means by which temperature is displayed.

properties.name: DisplaySize
properties.definition:
The physical size of the display.

In the case of a stem thermometer, this will be the length of the stem. For a dial thermometer, it will be the diameter of the dial.
